deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application for admission (domestic and international, most programs)
deadlines.notes: Applications open 1 Oct 2026 and are assessed on a rolling basis; apply early. The program pages for Computing Science, Economics and Engineering list the international deadline as 1 March 2027. Final transcripts and outstanding documents for high school applicants are due 1 Aug 2027. Some programs (Nursing, Dentistry, Medicine, Law) have their own timelines.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Every applicant must show English proficiency regardless of citizenship. Without a test: 3+ years of full-time English-medium education (at least 5 credit-bearing academic courses per year, plus Alberta Grade 12 or equivalent); a degree from an accredited English-medium university in an English-primary country; 3 years at a Council of International Schools member or US-regionally accredited school plus a passing senior non-ESL English course; 6 transferable university English credits at B+ or better, or EAP 136 + INT D 137; or attending a school in a university-listed ELP-exempt country. GCE applicants meet it with grade B or higher in (I)GCSE English Language or Literature.

english.notes: IELTS Academic. IELTS One Skill Retake is not accepted.
Old 0-120 scale, tests taken before 21 Jan 2026; no section below 21. Home Edition and Essentials not accepted.
New 1-6 scale, tests on or after 21 Jan 2026; no band below 4.5. The page notes the TOEFL figures are subject to final university governance approval.
No integrated subscore below 100. Valid through the 2028-2029 admission cycle.
PTE Academic; no communicative skill below 60.
Cambridge English: Advanced (CAE) or Proficiency (CPE); no skill below 170. CAEL 70 (no band below 60) is also accepted. Test results older than two years are not accepted.

tier_notes.general: QS World University Rankings 2027: world rank 96, 4th of the Canadian universities in the table (S = ranks 1-5 on the national scale; a national scale, so not comparable with US tiers).
